Narvasoft.evidence: Narvasoft is a registered sole proprietorship in Finland operating its official website, offering standard desktop accounting, invoicing, and basic ledger software rather than comprehensive automated, cloud-based accounts payable workflow lifecycle solutions. (Registries, Company Website)

Quoro Tech S.r.l..evidence: A company named Quoro Tech S.r.l. does not appear to exist; the software tool 'Quoro' and its listed domain quoro.tech are developed and owned by WeWill S.r.l. based in Milan, Italy. According to official company disclosures, Quoro functions as an AI document reconciliation and accounts payable automation software developed by WeWill S.r.l. rather than an independent corporate entity by that legal name.
